lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: do you have a moment?
What's wrong?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I have an urgent matter to discuss with you.
Tell me.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: While I was scouting the base a while ago,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I received a strange message from the Radio Tower.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I couldn't make it out very clearly since the signal wasn't that great.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: However, from what I could tell,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: someone on this base

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: is in a relationship with several Nikkes.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Whoever sent out this broadcast

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: said they would hunt this guy down to the ends of the earth if need be

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: and put them through such hell that they'd wish they were dead.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: End of report.
It's not me.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Sorry?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Oh, don't worry.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: You're not on my list of suspects.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: However, you're currently

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: the only human on this base.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I thought it best to bring this to your attention

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: and see if you could surmise who is behind the message.
Can you describe the voice of the person who sent the message?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: It was a shrill female voice, so

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: the speaker is estimated to be in her late 20's or early 30's.
That doesn't fit the profile of anyone in the base.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: If that's the case,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: who could have sent that message?
Perhaps there's a ghost in the Radio Tower
Maybe Ingrid stopped by

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Cut it out!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Who'd want to be on a night watch

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: after hearing a creepy ghost story?
Are you afraid of ghosts?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Not necessarily, but it's just that

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I know firearms have absolutely no effect on ghosts,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: so they'd be difficult to deal with, that's all.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Come again?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: No matter how fiery the boss's personality is,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: she would never interfere in other's romantic endeavors.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Wait a sec,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I just received an emergency call from Signal.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: One moment.
... Delta seems to be talking with Signal.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Eureka! So that's what it is!
Care to elaborate?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: While waiting at the Radio Tower today,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Signal watched the TV show Love and Gunshots.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: She was so caught up in it that she accidentally switched on her radio.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: She only just realized what happened and called me to explain.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: The female voice I heard on the radio was the actress in the TV show.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: She was furious upon discovering her husband having an affair

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: and was giving him a piece of her mind.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: End of report.
Delta

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Yes!
Make sure this doesn't happen again.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Yes, sir!
In the future, check in with the radio first before bringing such things to my attention.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Absolutely! I'm terribly sorry!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I apologize for any inconvenience caused!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'll report back to duty at once!
